planSteps.description: Find the password input field and enter 'My-Drop-Site' to unlock the site.
Go to any product detail page by clicking a product card from the homepage or collection.
Select a size if available, then click the Add to Cart button. Verify a confirmation appears or the cart badge updates.
Navigate to a different product and add it to the cart as well.
Click the cart icon in the header. Verify the cart opens showing both products with correct names, sizes, quantities, and prices.
In the cart, change the quantity of one item. Verify the subtotal and total update correctly.
Remove one item from the cart. Verify it disappears and the total updates.
Navigate to a product detail page and click the wishlist/heart icon to add it to the wishlist.
Navigate to /wishlist and verify the saved product appears in the wishlist.
On the wishlist page, remove the item. Verify it disappears from the list.
Add a product to cart and click Proceed to Checkout. Verify the checkout page loads with shipping details form.
Fill in the shipping details form with name, email, address, city, and phone number.
Leave required fields empty and try to proceed. Verify validation error messages appear for missing required fields.
